info.title: API.SH: Ausbildung.de
info.description: The Ausbildung.de API from API.SH: public Ausbildung.de data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An employer's open training places on Ausbildung.de (6 per page, as the site lists them) with its filters: location, profession, school leaving level, earliest start and direct application. Each place: id, slug, url, title, profession, training type, school leaving level, duration, start, location, open places, application options. `filters` lists the employer's professions (ids for `profession_id`), locations and levels. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ausbildung-de-company-jobs

get.description:
Apprenticeships, dual-study places and other training places in Germany on Ausbildung.de with every filter of the site's search: keywords, place and radius, professions, topics, industries, training type, school leaving level, earliest start and sort. Each result: `id`, `slug`, `url`, `title`, `profession`, training type, required school leaving level, duration, `starts_from`, location and postcode, number of open places and other locations, company (name, id, logo, rating, review count), branch and application options, plus `raw`. `nearby` lists the site's extra results from the surrounding area when it shows them. `total` is the number of matches (the site pages through the first 10,000). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Without `location` the search covers all of Germany.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ausbildung-de-search

parameters.name: profession
parameters.description: Profession names from /ausbildung-de/v1/filters (`professions[].name`, e.g. `Mechatroniker/in`); several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic names from /ausbildung-de/v1/filters (e.g. `Technik`); several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry name as the site lists it (e.g. `Automobil`); several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: graduation
parameters.description: School leaving level; several separated by `|`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
